with cal as (select cast(strftime(cal_date, '%Y%m%d') as int) as cd from read_parquet('/srv/share/quantdb/raw/trade_cal/**/*.parquet', hive_partitioning=true, union_by_name=true) where exchange='SSE' and is_open=1 and cal_date between date '2024-01-02' and date '2026-06-26'), listed as (select distinct ts_code from read_parquet(['/srv/share/quantdb/raw/daily/trade_date=2024*/**/*.parquet','/srv/share/quantdb/raw/daily/trade_date=2025*/**/*.parquet','/srv/share/quantdb/raw/daily/trade_date=2026*/**/*.parquet'], hive_partitioning=true, union_by_name=true) where trade_date between 20240102 and 20260626), bars as (select ts_code, count(distinct trade_date) n from read_parquet(['/srv/share/quantdb/raw/daily/trade_date=2024*/**/*.parquet','/srv/share/quantdb/raw/daily/trade_date=2025*/**/*.parquet','/srv/share/quantdb/raw/daily/trade_date=2026*/**/*.parquet'], hive_partitioning=true, union_by_name=true) where trade_date between 20240102 and 20260626 group by 1) select (select count(*) from cal), (select count(*) from listed), (select sum(n) from bars), round((select sum(n) from bars)::double / ((select count(*) from cal) * (select count(*) from listed)), 6)
endpoints.unit: 分母=测试期交易日数 × 测试期出现过的股票数；分子=实际 bar 数
